Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking this — Novacore (we’re the supply partner that will deliver instrumentation kits for your Q1 deployments). Procurement asked me to get our profile set up in your system so we can receive POs and submit invoices. Can you confirm the specific items you need to create a vendor profile and route POs properly?

To help speed things along, can you tell me:
- The preferred vendor intake form (Excel or online form)
- Where to upload our W-9 and remit instructions
- AP contact and PO formatting requirements (do you require PO numbers on invoices; any PO prefix?)
- How long after we return materials it takes to be active in your ERP

We’d like to avoid payment delays — happy to send the spreadsheet and W-9 now.

Best,

Hi Anna — happy to help.

Quick answers up front:
- Required items: completed vendor entity sheet (attached), signed W-9 (for US entities), remit/billing address, AP email, and preferred payment method (ACH or wire).
- Upload: secure Drive link (shared below) or you can reply with attachments — we prefer the portal for bank details.
- PO requirements: Redwood requires a PO number on every invoice; no fixed prefix but POs are 8-digit numeric strings. Please include the PO number in the invoice filename and on the invoice PDF.
- Timeline: once we have a fully completed sheet + W-9, finance typically creates the vendor record within 2–3 business days; AP testing/first payment can take up to 5 business days depending on bank verification.

Attachments I’m sending: entity_data_sheet.xlsx (please fill every field), a blank W-9.pdf for your signer. If you need a secure upload for bank details, we’ll provide a one-time portal link after you return the sheet.

Upload/links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-vendor-intake (please mark the folder with your company name)

Next steps for you:
1) Fill the attached Excel with legal name, entity type, tax ID, registered address, remit address, billing contact (name + email), AP contact (name + email), and your ERP vendor code if one exists.
2) Sign and return the W-9 (PDF).
3) If you prefer ACH, request the secure bank upload and we’ll issue the one-time link.

I’ve looped in Kimberly Park from AP (kimberly_park@redwood.ai) and Jordan Blake from procurement to help with routing and to expedite creation.

Thanks — I’ll monitor the folder and notify you when the record is live.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Vendor Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

Hi Anna — got everything, thanks. I uploaded a draft vendor master record and assigned vendor ID VN-20261130.

Answers to your questions:
- Yes, we can issue a $0 test PO to validate the payment channel. Please accept the PO and send a test remittance confirmation after you upload bank details.
- No additional US tax forms are required beyond the W-9 for vendor creation. If anything else is needed we’ll flag it.

AP/PO notes:
- Invoices must reference the Redwood PO number (8 digits). If an invoice arrives without a PO, it will be held for manual routing which delays payment.
- Preferred invoice format: PDF, filename should be COMPANY_PO.pdf (e.g., NOVACORE_00001234.pdf).

Next steps from Redwood:
1) Kimberly (cc’d) will finalize the vendor in our ERP and confirm ACH onboarding.
2) Once ACH is verified we’ll activate VN-20261130 and send the first PO (expected within 2 business days).
3) I’ll share a secure bank-upload link once Kimberly confirms the vendor record is staged.

Attachments: Vendor_Master_Record_VN-20261130.pdf (draft snapshot).

Kimberly — can you take point on ACH onboarding and confirm receipt when you’ve run the bank tokenization?

Thanks all — looking forward to getting Novacore live.

Regards,
